method: Held-out test rows loaded from models/split_indices.json — the literal case_id partition train_models.py used (stratified by fraud_type, test_size=0.2, random_state=42), not a separately recomputed split. Predicted-fraud rule: priority != LOW OR risk >= 0.50 (matches classifier.py FRAUD_DECISION_THRESHOLD).
disclaimer: Metrics are measured on a synthetic held-out test set generated by this prototype (generate_training_data.py) and are reported for demonstration purposes only — they are not evidence of accuracy on real cases.
